to use a sharp tool (such as a knife) to open or divide (something, such as paper or wood) 用锋利的工具（如刀）打开或分开（某物，如纸或木头） Cut the paper along/on the dotted line (with a pair of scissors). 用剪刀沿着虚线剪纸。 cutting a piece of string 剪一段绳子 He uses the ax to cut wood. 他用斧头劈木头。 The meat is so tender you can cut it with a fork.
The excitement/tension in the room was so thick you could cut it with a knife. [=there was a lot of excitement/tension in the room]
Cut along/on the dotted line.
The saw easily cuts through metal.
She cut into the melon with a knife. 这块肉非常嫩，用叉子就能切开。
房间里的兴奋/紧张气氛浓得几乎可以用刀切开。
请沿着虚线剪开。
锯子可以轻松锯断金属。
她用刀切开了瓜。 eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1::01k eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1::core eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1::v26.03.23

eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1 eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1::01k d56ad6fc-76d6-44ca-bb12-22e62dd1af19 6e75a46c-7997-4b60-97bc-fd27d9e15d41 cut verb ˈkʌt https://media.merriam-webster.com/soundc11/c/cut00001.wav + obj to make a hole or wound in (a person's skin) 在（某人的皮肤）上打一个洞或造成一个伤口 I cut myself while shaving. 我在刮胡子的时候割伤了自己。 I cut my finger on a sharp piece of metal. = A sharp piece of metal cut me (on the finger). 我被一块锋利的金属割伤了手指。 I had a cut finger. 我手指被割伤了。 We were fighting, and he tried to cut me with his knife.
Pieces of broken glass cut her face and arms.
He fell and cut his head open on a sharp rock. 我们在打架，他试图用刀割我。
碎玻璃划伤了她的脸和手臂。
他摔倒了，头被锋利的石头割破了。 eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1::01k eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1::core eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1::v26.03.23

eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1 eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1::01k 87fd99d1-e2ee-4528-bfcd-2441da69ae42 6e75a46c-7997-4b60-97bc-fd27d9e15d41 cut verb ˈkʌt https://media.merriam-webster.com/soundc11/c/cut00001.wav + obj to make (a hole) in something by using a sharp tool 用锋利的工具在某物上打（孔） They cut a hole in the wall for the new window. 他们在墙上开了一个洞，用于安装新窗户。 Doctors begin by cutting a small incision in the chest. 医生首先在胸部切开一个小切口。 Cut several slits in the top of the crust to allow air to escape. 在馅饼皮的顶部切几个缝隙，以便空气逸出。 eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1::01k eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1::core eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1::v26.03.23

eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1 eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1::01k 9eb89904-98a0-4478-80b7-932d2794ff9c 6e75a46c-7997-4b60-97bc-fd27d9e15d41 cut verb ˈkʌt https://media.merriam-webster.com/soundc11/c/cut00001.wav + obj [often + into] [often + from] [often + off]
to divide or separate parts of (something) by using a sharp tool 用锋利的工具将（某物）的部分分开或分割。 It's time to cut [=slice] the cake! 是时候切蛋糕了！ I'll cut the apple in half so you both can have some. 我会把苹果切成两半，这样你们俩都能吃到。 Would you cut me a slice of bread? = Would you cut a slice of bread for me? 你能帮我切一片面包吗？ Add one large onion that has been cut into one-inch pieces.
The chicken is cut into long strips and served on top of the salad.
Her walls were covered with pictures cut from magazines.
a piece of meat that is cut from the hind end of the animal
She was cutting off pieces of watermelon and giving them to the children. 加入一颗切成一英寸块的大洋葱。
鸡肉被切成长条，放在沙拉上食用。
她的墙上贴满了从杂志上剪下来的图片。
一块从动物后部切下来的肉。
她正在切西瓜块分给孩子们。 eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1::01k eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1::extend eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1::v26.03.23

eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1 eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1::01k 4cd34476-b8c3-43bc-bc38-e7922f6b2dde 6e75a46c-7997-4b60-97bc-fd27d9e15d41 cut verb ˈkʌt https://media.merriam-webster.com/soundc11/c/cut00001.wav + obj to make (hair, grass, etc.) shorter by using a sharp tool (such as scissors) 用锋利的工具（如剪刀）使（头发、草等）变短 I cut my hair short for the summer. 我为了夏天把头发剪短了。 Where'd you get your hair cut? 你在哪里剪的头发？ I need to cut [=trim] my nails; they're way too long. 我需要剪指甲；它们太长了。 She keeps her nails cut short.
The grass in our yard needs to be cut. [=mowed]
the smell of fresh-cut grass
The wood is already cut to size/length. [=it has already been cut so that it is the proper size/length] 她一直把指甲剪得很短。
我们院子的草需要修剪了。
新割的草的气味
木材已经按尺寸/长度切割好了。 eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1::01k eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1::extend eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1::v26.03.23

eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1 eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1::01k cd57d394-344c-4c02-b21b-3ece91f85aec 6e75a46c-7997-4b60-97bc-fd27d9e15d41 cut verb ˈkʌt https://media.merriam-webster.com/soundc11/c/cut00001.wav [usually used as (be) cut]
to give (hair or clothing) a certain style by cutting it 通过剪裁（头发或衣服）来赋予其某种风格 Her hair is light brown and cut in a short bob. 她的头发是浅棕色的，剪成了短波波头。 She was wearing a dress that was cut low at the neck. [=she was wearing a low-cut dress] 她穿着一件领口很低的连衣裙。 eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1::01k eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1::extend eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1::v26.03.23

eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1 eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1::01k 474c4b6b-b0e5-484b-8ec7-8042048486fe 6e75a46c-7997-4b60-97bc-fd27d9e15d41 cut verb ˈkʌt https://media.merriam-webster.com/soundc11/c/cut00001.wav to give (something) a new shape by using a sharp tool 用锋利的工具给（某物）重新塑形 a beautifully cut diamond 一颗切工精美的钻石 eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1::01k eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1::rare eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1::v26.03.23

eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1 eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1::01k 0615c0f0-c023-4a58-8d0b-786c3031e461 6e75a46c-7997-4b60-97bc-fd27d9e15d41 cut verb ˈkʌt https://media.merriam-webster.com/soundc11/c/cut00001.wav + obj [often + out]
to make or form (something) by cutting or removing material 通过切割或去除材料来制作或形成（某物） We all cut [=carved] our names on/into the tree. 我们都在树上刻下了自己的名字。 The stream cuts a path through the woods. 小溪在树林中开辟出一条小路。 builders cutting new roads in the forest 建筑工人在森林中开辟新道路 At the center of the table was a statue cut out of ice. 桌子中央摆放着一个用冰雕刻的雕像。 eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1::01k eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1::rare eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1::v26.03.23

eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1 eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1::01k 696fcf55-c3c1-42c3-beb0-183a7f1a1f50 6e75a46c-7997-4b60-97bc-fd27d9e15d41 cut verb ˈkʌt https://media.merriam-webster.com/soundc11/c/cut00001.wav + obj [often + off]
to make the amount of (something) smaller reduce 使（某物）的数量变小；减少 Our benefits were recently cut at work. 我们公司的福利最近被削减了。 The drug has been shown to cut the risk of heart attack by half. 该药物已被证明能将心脏病发作的风险降低一半。 In just three years, the mayor has cut the city's crime in half. 仅仅三年时间，市长就将该市的犯罪率减少了一半。 The President has promised to cut government spending.
Cutting taxes can have positive and negative effects on the economy.
measures that are designed to cut costs = cost-cutting measures
The company's expenses had been cut to the bone. [=reduced to their lowest possible amount]
This route can cut as much as five minutes off your driving time.
Drug abuse cut many years off (of) his life. [=shortened his life by many years]
We've cut 20 percent off the regular retail price. 总统已承诺削减政府开支。
减税对经济可能产生积极和消极的影响。
旨在削减成本的措施
公司的开支已被削减到极限。
这条路线可以为你的驾车时间节省多达五分钟。
药物滥用让他的寿命缩短了许多年。
我们已在原零售价基础上打了八折。 eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1::01k eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1::rare eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1::v26.03.23

eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1 eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1::01k 141e9f5b-aaad-4d38-8139-ad0bee5ee79e 6e75a46c-7997-4b60-97bc-fd27d9e15d41 cut verb ˈkʌt https://media.merriam-webster.com/soundc11/c/cut00001.wav to make (a book, film, etc.) shorter by removing parts 通过删减部分内容使（书籍、电影等）变得更短 His article was cut [=shortened] by about 500 words. 他的文章被删减了大约500字。 The movie had to be cut because it was too long. 这部电影因为太长而不得不被剪辑。 eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1::01k eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1::rare eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1::v26.03.23

eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1 eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1::01k b722c16f-b4e9-4a5d-aaa3-ffb12bec7596 6e75a46c-7997-4b60-97bc-fd27d9e15d41 cut verb ˈkʌt https://media.merriam-webster.com/soundc11/c/cut00001.wav [often + from]
to remove (something) from a book, film, etc. 将（某物）从书籍、电影等中删除 The movie's director decided to cut [=cut out, omit] my part. 电影导演决定删掉我的部分。 The director cut the scene from the final version of the film. 导演将该场景从电影的最终版本中删去了。 They decided to cut her report from the newscast. 他们决定将她的报道从新闻播报中删去。 About 500 words were cut from his article. 他的文章被删减了大约500个单词。 eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1::01k eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1::rare eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1::v26.03.23

eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1 eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1::01k b9d50282-5539-4f31-ae28-7c00582c081f 6e75a46c-7997-4b60-97bc-fd27d9e15d41 cut verb ˈkʌt https://media.merriam-webster.com/soundc11/c/cut00001.wav + obj to remove (something) from a computer document in a way that allows you to move it to another part of the document or to another document 从计算机文档中移除（某物），以便可以将其移动到文档的其他部分或另一个文档中。 After you select the text with your mouse, you can cut it and then paste it at the beginning of the paragraph. 在你用鼠标选中这段文字后，你可以将其剪切，然后粘贴到段落的开头。 You can cut and paste the picture into your file. 你可以将图片剪切并粘贴到你的文件中。 eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1::01k eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1::rare eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1::v26.03.23

eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1 eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1::01k 3e42996c-9794-4651-af28-1df23a2a4fa1 6e75a46c-7997-4b60-97bc-fd27d9e15d41 cut verb ˈkʌt https://media.merriam-webster.com/soundc11/c/cut00001.wav + obj to remove (a plant or part of a plant) by cutting it 通过切割来去除（植物或植物的一部分） It's illegal to cut [=cut down] trees in this forest. 在这片森林里砍伐树木是违法的。 We'll start cutting and harvesting the wheat next week. 我们下周将开始割麦和收割小麦。 [A cut flower is a flower that has been cut off the plant that it grew on.] He brought her a bouquet of cut flowers. 他给她带来了一束切花。 eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1::01k eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1::rare eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1::v26.03.23

eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1 eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1::01k 5eb11834-a94c-41dd-8ebd-ccee72f1bece 6e75a46c-7997-4b60-97bc-fd27d9e15d41 cut verb ˈkʌt https://media.merriam-webster.com/soundc11/c/cut00001.wav + obj to cause (something) to no longer be connected 使（某物）不再连接 The enemy has cut [=severed] our supply lines. 敌人已经切断了我们的补给线。 He wanted to cut all ties with his past and start a new life. 他想与过去彻底断绝关系，开始新的生活。 eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1::01k eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1::rare eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1::v26.03.23

eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1 eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1::01k d69e4506-9dca-4e62-87bf-94093269c9e3 6e75a46c-7997-4b60-97bc-fd27d9e15d41 cut verb ˈkʌt https://media.merriam-webster.com/soundc11/c/cut00001.wav + obj to allow (someone or something) to be free, loose, etc., by cutting something that stops movement 通过切断阻止其移动的东西，使（某人或某物）变得自由、松开等。 They were trapped inside the crushed car and had to be cut free. = They had to be cut from the car. 他们被困在被撞毁的汽车里，不得不被切割救出。 The boat was cut loose from the pier and allowed to drift away. 船被从码头解开，任其漂走。 eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1::01k eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1::rare eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1::v26.03.23

eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1 eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1::01k 447a8f4a-e7fb-40ab-8281-c3b6ff3f3254 6e75a46c-7997-4b60-97bc-fd27d9e15d41 cut verb ˈkʌt https://media.merriam-webster.com/soundc11/c/cut00001.wav + obj [often + from]
to remove (someone) from a team, organization, etc. 将（某人）从团队、组织等中移除 I was on the team for two weeks before I got cut. 我在队里待了两周就被淘汰了。 The coach cut two players from the team. 教练把两名球员从队伍中裁掉了。 The band was cut from the show at the last minute. 乐队在最后一刻被从演出中撤下了。 eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1::01k eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1::rare eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1::v26.03.23

eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1 eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1::01k 0d143810-08da-4618-a165-a2d2f3483872 6e75a46c-7997-4b60-97bc-fd27d9e15d41 cut verb ˈkʌt https://media.merriam-webster.com/soundc11/c/cut00001.wav to divide (a pack of cards) into two piles 把（一副牌）分成两堆 You cut the deck and I'll deal. 你切牌，我来发牌。 You cut and I'll deal. 你切牌，我发牌。 eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1::01k eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1::rare eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1::v26.03.23

eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1 eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1::01k 401a352c-ff3c-4167-9a4a-563b32c75368 6e75a46c-7997-4b60-97bc-fd27d9e15d41 cut verb ˈkʌt https://media.merriam-webster.com/soundc11/c/cut00001.wav + obj to divide (an area of land) into two parts 将（一块土地）分成两部分 The river cuts the city in half. 这条河把城市一分为二。 The mountain ridges are cut by deep valleys. 山脊被深谷切割。 eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1::01k eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1::rare eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1::v26.03.23

eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1 eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1::01k 9bb8c5fe-2ede-4c12-b453-450a74796ce1 6e75a46c-7997-4b60-97bc-fd27d9e15d41 cut verb ˈkʌt https://media.merriam-webster.com/soundc11/c/cut00001.wav no obj [often used figuratively to describe something that is not limited in the usual way]
to move or go across or through something 穿越或通过某物 Let's take a shortcut and cut across this field. 让我们抄近路，穿过这片田野吧。 We cut through the park on our way home. 我们回家的路上穿过了公园。 The boundary line between the two countries cuts directly through the group's traditional homeland. 两国之间的边界线直接穿过该群体的传统家园。 National security is an issue that cuts across party lines. [=an issue that is important to both political parties]
Child abuse cuts across all economic and racial lines/boundaries. [=it occurs in all economic and racial groups]
Her academic interests cut across [=involve or relate to] many disciplines. 国家安全是一个跨越党派界限的问题。
虐待儿童现象存在于所有经济和种族群体。
她的学术兴趣涉及许多学科。 eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1::01k eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1::rare eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1::v26.03.23

eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1 eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1::01k ed340e94-77a0-4f17-a995-96cc8763dee3 6e75a46c-7997-4b60-97bc-fd27d9e15d41 cut verb ˈkʌt https://media.merriam-webster.com/soundc11/c/cut00001.wav to move quickly 迅速移动 a fast ship cutting through the waves 一艘快速的船劈波斩浪 eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1::01k eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1::rare eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1::v26.03.23

eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1 eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1::01k 4f6f045a-cadf-4be5-a48f-479bfa6b92dc 6e75a46c-7997-4b60-97bc-fd27d9e15d41 cut verb ˈkʌt https://media.merriam-webster.com/soundc11/c/cut00001.wav to move suddenly in a different direction 突然转向不同的方向 The driver cut across three lanes of traffic to get to his exit and nearly caused an accident. 司机为了驶向出口，横穿了三条车道，差点引发了一场事故。 (American football) The runner cut to his left to avoid being tackled. （美式橄榄球）持球队员向左变向，以避免被擒抱。 eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1::01k eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1::rare eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1::v26.03.23

eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1 eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1::01k b36d06e9-6bf6-4010-9df9-e2126d5ef633 6e75a46c-7997-4b60-97bc-fd27d9e15d41 cut verb ˈkʌt https://media.merriam-webster.com/soundc11/c/cut00001.wav no obj [often + in]
to move in front of other people in a line 在排队时插到其他人前面 That guy cut to the head of the line. 那个人插队到队伍最前面了。 She cut in front of us. = She cut ahead of us. 她插到我们前面了。 Our friends let us cut in in front of them. 我们的朋友让我们插队到他们前面。 Celebrities are allowed to cut in line at popular restaurants.
